description.zh: 文件代码内容，不同代码类型（fileType）的文件，代码格式不同。您可以在运维中心找到对应类型的任务，右键单击查看代码，查看具体的代码格式。
description.en: The code content of the file. The code format varies depending on the code type (fileType). You can locate a job of the corresponding type in the Operation Center, right-click it, and select View Code to check the specific code format.

description.zh:
文件的代码类型。

不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见[DataWorks节点合集](~~600169~~)。
您也可以调用[ListFileType](~~212428~~)接口，查询文件的代码类型。
description.en:
The code type of the file. Different file types correspond to different code types. For more information, see [DataWorks Node Types](~~600169~~).
You can also invoke the [ListFileType](~~212428~~) API to query the code types of files.
The name of the original resource file.

description.zh: 文件责任人的阿里云用户ID。如果该参数为空，则默认使用调用者的阿里云用户ID。
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud User ID of the file owner. If this parameter is empty, the Alibaba Cloud User ID of the caller is used by default.

description.zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。需要用该参数来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console, go to the workspace configuration page, and obtain the workspace ID. This parameter is required to identify the DataWorks workspace for this API call.

description.zh: 是否将资源同步上传到计算引擎。
description.en: Indicates whether to synchronize and upload the resource to the compute engine.
The OSS URL for file upload provided by POP.

description.zh: 资源文件在计算引擎上的存储路径，目前只有EMR和CDH用到该字段。EMR格式为[osshdfs]://path/to/object，CDH默认需要填写为/user/admin/lib。
description.en: The Storage Path of the resource file on the compute engine. This field is currently used only by EMR and CDH. The EMR format is \[osshdfs]://path/to/object, and for CDH, the default value must be /user/admin/lib.

description.zh:
文件资源上传模式。目前仅对MaxCompute的File类型文件生效，取值如下：

- true：可下载的资源模式。

- false：在线编辑的文本模式。
description.en:
The upload mode for the resource file. This parameter currently applies only to File-type files in MaxCompute. Valid values:

- true: Downloadable resource mode.

- false: Online-editable text mode.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public create-resource-file --project-id 10000 --file-folder-path Business_process/First_Business_Process/MaxCompute/Folder_1/Folder_2 --file-name Filename --file-type 10 --file-description This_is_a_description --owner 1000000000001 --content SHOW_TABLES --resource-file http://bucketname1.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example --origin-resource-name origin_file_name.sql --upload-mode false --register-to-calc-engine false --storage-url oss://oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/emr-test --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public CreateResourceFile --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceFile 'http://bucketname1.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example' --FileDescription This_is_a_description --Owner 1000000000001 --FileType 10 --UploadMode false --Content SHOW_TABLES --OriginResourceName 'origin_file_name.sql' --FileName Filename --ProjectId 10000 --FileFolderPath 'Business_process/First_Business_Process/MaxCompute/Folder_1/Folder_2' --RegisterToCalcEngine false --StorageURL 'oss://oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/emr-test'
